name: evaqueue
description: EvaQueue.js provide a unified API across different high performance queue backends, including Kafka, AliMNS

scripts.build: rm -rf lib && tsc -m "System" --outFile "lib/index" --sourceMap "false" && rm lib/index && mv lib/index.d.ts ./ && tsc
scripts.install:peers:ci: npm install save $(jq -r '.peerDependencies | to_entries | map("\(.key)@\(.value | tostring)") | join(" ")' package.json)
scripts.install:peers: npm install --no-save $(jq -r '.peerDependencies | to_entries | map("\(.key)@\(.value | tostring)") | join(" ")' package.json)
scripts.install:peers:mac: CPPFLAGS=-I/usr/local/opt/openssl/include LDFLAGS=-L/usr/local/opt/openssl/lib npm install --no-save $(jq -r '.peerDependencies | to_entries | map("\(.key)@\(.value | tostring)") | join(" ")' package.json)

author: BMQB Team
